These errors manifest as systematic overprojection of totals and misalignment of prop outcomes. The fix involves implementing probabilistic constraints on target sharing, regime-switching logic for situational behavior, and dynamic gates to prevent overreaction to line shifts. Each primitive addresses one failure mode: Dirichlet-Multinomial ensures bounded allocations, Regime-Switching adapts to game state, and Steam/CLV Gate prevents spurious confidence in volatile lines.
